summary: SUP-1040 (Zenith Electronics Pvt Ltd) has a 96-hour factory outage. Open PO-1015 (1200 units of ITM-540, due 2026-12-03) is affected, with INR 474384.00 exposed. DC-PUNE stock covers 0.5 days, so a shortage is expected. No qualified alternate supplier for ITM-540 exists in the ERP data, and SUP-1040's capacity and restart date are unknown.
facts: The event reports a 96-hour factory outage at SUP-1040.
PO-1015 orders 1200 units of ITM-540, due 2026-12-03.
DC-PUNE is the only location holding ITM-540, with 150 units on hand.
The snapshot contains no alternate supplier for ITM-540.

estimates.statement: DC-PUNE runs out of ITM-540 before PO-1015 can arrive.
estimates.basis: impact.inventory_coverage_days is less than the delay; impact.shortage is true

assumptions: The outage duration reported in the event is accurate.
missing_data: no qualified alternate supplier for ITM-540
